conviction_note: The day's news came out the day before the report: an MAR release at 08:55 CET on 11-12 said partnerships are delayed and staff will be cut, and the stock fell about 72% to 0.60 SEK. That leaves a market cap of about 89 MSEK against estimated Q3 cash of about 80-90 MSEK, which is a mild valuation-floor lean up. Stage R's base rate for deep falls on heavy volume leans toward continuation. Net, p_up is 53 on an abs_move of 15 (realised vol 261%, a day after a -72% move), which gives +0.9. The findings sum to +1.0, so the two measurements agree.

already_public.what: Strategic shift released as MAR inside information the day before the report. About 10 positions (30% of staff) are being cut, the likelihood of new partnership deals in 2026 has fallen, some potential partners have ended talks, a CBO is being recruited, and costs fall about 8 MSEK a year from Q3 2027. Stock about -72% on the day.

Q2 cash was SEK 34.2m; the rights-issue proceeds of about SEK 67.4m net (after costs and Fenja amortisation) were received in August 2026; the Fenja loan of SEK 18.5m runs to 2027-11-30; management said the company is funded beyond the mid-2027 LIFT-PD readout
CEO to step down in Q1 2027

findings.finding: After today's -72% the market cap (148.7m shares x 0.60 SEK, about 89 MSEK) roughly equals the Q3 cash the report should show: SEK 34.2m at Q2 plus about 67.4m received in August, less about 15m of Q3 burn, so about 85m. That puts enterprise value near the 18.5m Fenja loan for a Phase III-ready mesdopetam and an Otsuka-funded linepemat program.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed history. The baseline history is cadence-estimated (median 4.56%) and is a lower bound.
findings.why_not_priced: Today was a capitulation session: the stock opened at 1.20 and slid all day to about 0.60 on turnover of about 30% of shares outstanding. Sellers were exiting on the partnership news rather than on cash. Had the cash floor been priced in, the slide would have stopped well above cash per share (about 0.57 SEK). The cash number is computable from the Q2 report, though, so this is mostly a reminder, not news. That is why it is sized small.

findings.finding: Today's fall is a deep fall (-72%) on extreme volume (about 44m shares against a 20-day norm of about 1-2m). Stage R's phase-0 base rates (US) say falls below -40% average -4.0% the next session and falls on >15x volume -2.44%, so continuation is the default against any bounce.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a base rate, not information. It is filed because it is the measured default the bounce case has to beat. It is a US proxy, so it is sized small.

outside_window.finding: The Fenja loan carries a covenant on loan amount relative to market value. It was breached at 2025-12-31 and 2026-03-31 and cost SEK 3m of amortisation each time; at about 89 MSEK market cap a year-end breach is plausible, testing on 2026-12-31.
